blockingFindings.description: With Blender Cloth self-collision enabled, direct inspection of all five views and six pose renders shows the overskirt expands into a dense mass of sharp, chaotic folds that projects far outside the hips and obscures its pleated silhouette. The side and three-quarter profiles show severe lateral ballooning; the crouch and sit retain thigh exposure and a long rear panel. Self-collision worsens the already rejected V172 appearance.

Irregular gray body-colored patches remain visible across the white chest and waist in neutral, arms-up, and arm-cross renders. The current evidence does not identify whether they are intersections, exposed source surfaces, or shading, so the cause remains unresolved.
In crouch and sit, both shorts-clad thighs still project in front of the overskirt while the center front panel falls behind them. Coverage and clearance remain unacceptable in bent-leg poses.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
